literal_source_uses:
Let $F$ be a field and $q\in F^{\times}$ with **finite** quantum characteristic
$e=e(F,q)$, $2\le e<\infty$
([[def-quantum-characteristic-of-an-invertible-hecke-parameter]]), let
$I=\mathbb Z/e\mathbb Z$ be the residue set with integer residue labels
$0,1,\dots,e-1$, and use the cyclic affine type-A Cartan datum with dominant
weights $P^+$ and pairing $(\Lambda,\alpha_i)$
([[def-cyclic-affine-type-a-cartan-datum]]). In the nondegenerate branch the
distinct spectral values of the labels are $q^i$, while in the degenerate
branch they are $i\cdot1_F$ (here $e=\operatorname{char}F$). Fix
$\Lambda\in P^+$ of level $\ell=\sum_{i\in I}(\Lambda,\alpha_i)$ and put
$\lambda_i:=(\Lambda,\alpha_i)\ge0$.
direct.focused_clause_check: Definition cyclotomic exponents lambda_i=(Lambda,alpha_i) and level=sum lambda_i now equal the integral coroot labels by normalized source4.1; no consumer formula edit required; preserves any field and finite e>=2.

literal_source_uses:
**Hecke side.** Fix the level-one fundamental weight $\Lambda_0$ of the cyclic
affine type-$A$ datum with all $d_i=1$ and charge $0$
([[def-cyclic-affine-type-a-cartan-datum]]). With the conventions of
`def-affine-and-cyclotomic-type-a-hecke-algebras`, $H^\Lambda_d=H_{F,\xi}(S_d)$
is the finite type-$A$ Hecke algebra $T_r^2=(\xi-1)T_r+\xi$
(`prop-cyclotomic-hecke-algebras-of-level-one-are-finite-hecke-algebras`), and
$H^\Lambda_\alpha=e_\alpha H^\Lambda_d$ are its residue-content blocks
(`def-residue-sequence-idempotents-and-cyclotomic-hecke-blocks`).

[F2] The level-one cyclic affine type-$A$ datum has all $d_i=1$, charge $0$,
and $\langle\Lambda_0,\alpha_i\rangle=\delta_{i,0}$
([[def-cyclic-affine-type-a-cartan-datum]]).
direct.focused_clause_check: F2 and Verification1.1 require (Lambda0,alpha_i)=delta_i0 for Hecke and KLR exponents. Three weight-weight angle-pairing occurrences are corrected to symmetric parentheses; Definition/branch/claims unchanged.

literal_source_uses:
Fix a finite integer $e \ge 2$ and charge $0$, with the independent-root affine
Cartan datum, its lattices and its diagram reflection $\tau$ fixed as in
[[def-cyclic-affine-type-a-cartan-datum]]: $I = \mathbb{Z}/e\mathbb{Z}$, simple
roots $\alpha_i$, fundamental weights $\Lambda_i$, $\delta$, and
$\tau(i) = -i$. A *node* is a pair $(r,c) \in \mathbb{N} \times \mathbb{N}$, and
the *residue* of a node is $\operatorname{res}(r,c) := c - r \bmod e$; this is
the level-one, charge-$0$ specialization of the residue used in
[[def-residue-signature-normal-good-conormal-and-cogood-nodes]]. We use the
English convention (rows increase downwards) and the node language of
[[def-removable-and-addable-nodes-of-a-partition]] and
[[def-partition-young-diagram-and-conjugate-partition]].

**Given:** A finite integer $e \ge 2$; the affine Cartan datum and its lattices
with the diagram reflection $\tau$, $\tau(i) = -i$, preserving the pairing
([[def-cyclic-affine-type-a-cartan-datum]]); the charge-$0$ Fock space
$F_{\mathrm{QG}}$ with basis $|\lambda\rangle$ over all partitions, weight
$\operatorname{wt}(|\lambda\rangle) = \Lambda_0 - \sum_i m_i(\lambda)\alpha_i$
and declared node operators $F_i$, $E_i$, $K_h$
([[def-level-one-partition-fock-space-and-node-residues]]); and the node
vocabulary of [[def-removable-and-addable-nodes-of-a-partition]] and
[[def-partition-young-diagram-and-conjugate-partition]].

2.2 Step 1.2 also gives the weight bookkeeping: the transposition bijects the residue-$i$ nodes of $\lambda$ onto the residue-$(-i)$ nodes of $\lambda'$, so $m_i(\lambda) = m_{-i}(\lambda')$ for every $i$. Hence $\operatorname{wt}(|\lambda'\rangle) = \Lambda_0 - \sum_j m_j(\lambda')\alpha_j = \Lambda_0 - \sum_j m_{-j}(\lambda)\alpha_j = \tau(\operatorname{wt}(M_\lambda))$: applying the transposition of labels to the weight is the reflection $i \mapsto -i$ on the coefficients. In particular the relabelled basis vector $M_\lambda$ is a weight vector of weight $\operatorname{wt}(M_\lambda)$ for the transported toral action, since $K_h^{\mathrm{sym}} M_\lambda = J^{-1}K_{\tau h}^{\mathrm{QG}} J M_\lambda = q^{\langle \tau h, \operatorname{wt}(|\lambda'\rangle)\rangle} M_\lambda = q^{\langle h, \tau\, \operatorname{wt}(|\lambda'\rangle)\rangle} M_\lambda = q^{\langle h, \operatorname{wt}(M_\lambda)\rangle} M_\lambda$, using that $\tau$ preserves the pairing and exchanges $h_j$ with $h_{-j}$ ([[def-cyclic-affine-type-a-cartan-datum]]). [given, step 1.2, F1, F4, algebra]

$q_i=q$ for all $i$. Choose once and for all the representatives
$j\in\{1,\dots,e\}$ of the residues of $I$, so that $j=e$ represents the residue
$0$; all indices $j-1$, $j+1$ below are read in this representative range.

**Given:** The cyclic affine type $A$ Cartan datum of [[def-cyclic-affine-type-a-cartan-datum]] with residues $I=\mathbb Z/e\mathbb Z$, $e\ge2$; the representatives $j\in\{1,\dots,e\}$; the spaces $V$ and $V_{\mathrm{aff}}$ with the displayed operators, crystal data, tensor rule and energy function; a charge $M\in\mathbb Z$ with ground sequence $b^\circ_s=u_{M-s}$.

[F2] The datum has $\langle\alpha_j,h_i\rangle=a_{ij}$, $\langle\alpha_i,d\rangle=\delta_{i0}$, $\langle\Lambda_j,h_i\rangle=\delta_{ij}$, $\langle\delta,h_i\rangle=0$, $\langle\Lambda_j,d\rangle=0$ and $\langle\delta,d\rangle=1$ ([[def-cyclic-affine-type-a-cartan-datum]]).

[F3] For $e\ge3$, $\alpha_i=-\Lambda_{i-1}+2\Lambda_i-\Lambda_{i+1}$ and for $e=2$, $\alpha_0=2\Lambda_0-2\Lambda_1+\delta$, $\alpha_1=-2\Lambda_0+2\Lambda_1$; in all cases $\lambda_j-\lambda_{j-1}=\alpha_{j-1}$ and $\lambda_1+\delta-\lambda_e=\alpha_0$ with $\lambda_j:=\Lambda_j-\Lambda_{j-1}$ ([[def-cyclic-affine-type-a-cartan-datum]]).

[F4] The level of $\lambda\in P$ is $\langle c,\lambdaangle$; $\lambda_j$ has level $0$ and $\Lambda_i$, as an element of $P_{\mathrm{cl}}=P/\mathbb Z\delta$, has level $1$; $q
eq q^{-1}$ in $\mathbb Q(q)$, and $q^m
e1$ for $m
e0$ ([[def-cyclic-affine-type-a-cartan-datum]], [[def-kac-moody-integral-and-dominant-integral-weights]]).

[F6] For all $m\in\mathbb Z$ the identities $\langle\lambda_{j(m)},h_i\rangle=\delta_{i,j(m)}-\delta_{i,j(m)-1}$ and $\langle\lambda_{j(m)}+a(m)\delta,d\rangle=a(m)$ hold ([[def-cyclic-affine-type-a-cartan-datum]]).

literal_source_uses:
**The charged cyclic specialization.** Let $A=F$ be a field, let
$z=q_H\in F^{\times}$ have finite quantum characteristic $e\ge2$
([[def-quantum-characteristic-of-an-invertible-hecke-parameter]]), and let
$I=\mathbb Z/e\mathbb Z$ be the cyclic **label set** of residues, with a
dominant cyclic type-A weight $(\lambda_i)_{i\in I}$, $\lambda_i\ge0$, and
$\ell=\sum_i\lambda_i$
([[def-cyclic-affine-type-a-cartan-datum]]). If $q_H\ne1$ use the
nondegenerate presentation and put $c_i:=q_H^{\,i}$; if $q_H=1$ (which forces
$\operatorname{char}F=e$) use the degenerate presentation and put
$c_i:=i\cdot1_F$. Impose
$$f(z_1)=\prod_{i\in I}(z_1-c_i)^{\lambda_i}$$
on the first generator ($z_1=X_1$ in the nondegenerate branch and $z_1=x_1$ in
the degenerate branch) and write $H_d^\Lambda$ for the resulting **charged
cyclotomic quotient** of rank $d$. This charged finite-$e$ branch is the scope
of the present page; the arbitrary-base affine and monic definitions above
supply its universal PBW and trace proof inputs. The definition itself asserts
no basis, no spectrum, no primitive block decomposition and no
Brundan–Kleshchev isomorphism. The grading variable $v$ of the KLR side is
independent of $q_H$.
direct.focused_clause_check: Charged cyclic Definition consumes residue set, dominant integral labels and level=sum labels; unchanged, now also compatible with normalized symmetric form.

literal_source_uses:
Let $F,q,e,I,\Lambda,\lambda_i$ be as in
[[def-affine-and-cyclotomic-type-a-hecke-algebras]]
([[def-quantum-characteristic-of-an-invertible-hecke-parameter]],
[[def-cyclic-affine-type-a-cartan-datum]]). On the cyclic affine type-A Cartan
datum take the normalized symmetrizers $d_i=1$ and define the **type-A KLR
datum** $Q^{\mathrm A}$ by
$$Q^{\mathrm A}_{ii}=0,\qquad Q^{\mathrm A}_{ij}=1\quad\text{if }a_{ij}=0,$$
$$Q^{\mathrm A}_{i,i+1}(u,v)=v-u,\qquad Q^{\mathrm A}_{i+1,i}(u,v)=u-v\qquad(e\ge3),$$
$$Q^{\mathrm A}_{01}(u,v)=Q^{\mathrm A}_{10}(u,v)=-(u-v)^2\qquad(e=2).$$
Write $R_\alpha$ for the resulting generalized KLR algebra over $F$
([[def-quiver-hecke-klr-algebra-for-a-symmetrizable-cartan-datum]],
[[def-klr-grading-and-diagrammatic-composition]]) and $R^\Lambda_\alpha$ for
the standard cyclotomic quotient of
[[def-cyclotomic-klr-quotient-at-a-dominant-weight]] (monic first-strand
relations $x_1^{\lambda_{i_1}}e(\nu)=0$).
direct.focused_clause_check: Definition uses unchanged cyclic A and normalized d_i=1, including e2 Q01=Q10=-(u-v)^2, and cyclotomic coroot exponents from Hecke Definition; normalized form restores those labels.
Actual dependency uses unchanged e2 double-edge A and Fock residue action; no normalized full-weight form or level-one finite-hyperplane premise.

literal_source_uses:
Let $F$ be any field, $I=\mathbb Z/e\mathbb Z$ with finite $e\ge2$, and use the
standard homogeneous cyclotomic KLR quotient at $\Lambda=\sum_i\lambda_i\Lambda_i$
for the cyclic affine type-A Cartan datum and admissible graded parameters
([[def-cyclic-affine-type-a-cartan-datum]],
[[def-cyclotomic-klr-quotient-at-a-dominant-weight]]). Put
$\ell=\sum_i\lambda_i$ and
$$B_d=\bigoplus_{\operatorname{ht}\beta=d}R^\Lambda(\beta).$$
Then $\dim_FB_d=\ell^dd!$ for $d>0$, and $B_0=F$ has dimension one. The proof
uses the basic first induction-restriction adjunction and the mixed relations
on projective $K_0$ modulo $v-1$, where $v$ is the formal grading variable,
independent of any Hecke parameter $q_H$. No Frobenius theorem, tensor-form
perfectness, highest-weight or global-basis isometry, or Hecke basis is
required. If $\ell=0$ and $d>0$, then $B_d=0$.
direct.focused_clause_check: Statement uses independent roots, e>=2, dominant coefficients lambda_i and ell=sumlambda_i; no defect/auxiliary form input. Whole norm proof remains its actual owner scope.

In the situation of

$d^A(\lambda)$ for an ADDABLE $i$-node $A$ to be the number of addable
$i$-nodes strictly ABOVE $A$ minus the number of removable $i$-nodes strictly
ABOVE $A$. Define the codegree of a standard tableau $T$ by
$\operatorname{codeg}(\varnothing):=0$ and
$\operatorname{codeg}(T):=d^A(\mu^A)+\operatorname{codeg}(T_{\le d-1})$, where
$A$ is the node containing $d$ and $\mu^A=\mu\setminus A$. Define the defect of
a residue content $\alpha\in Q_+$ by
$\operatorname{def}(\alpha):=(\Lambda_0,\alpha)-(\alpha,\alpha)/2$ (the
symmetric form of [[def-cyclic-affine-type-a-cartan-datum]]). Then for every
partition $\mu$ with content $\alpha$ and every standard $\mu$-tableau $T$:

[[def-cyclic-affine-type-a-cartan-datum]]; the root lattice and its positive

literal_source_uses:
Work over $\mathbb Q(q)$ with a symmetrizable Cartan datum of type $A$ as in
[[def-cyclic-affine-type-a-cartan-datum]], put $q_i=q^{d_i}$ and let
$B$ be a unital $\mathbb Q(q)$-algebra equipped with elements
$E_i,F_i,K_h^{\pm1}$ ($i\in I$, $h\in P^\vee$) satisfying the toral and
toral-action relations and the mixed commutators
$E_iF_j-F_jE_i=\delta_{ij}(K_i-K_i^{-1})/(q_i-q_i^{-1})$ of
[[def-drinfeld-jimbo-quantized-enveloping-algebra]]; assume that every element of
every $B$-module $W$ on which the toral elements act diagonally generates a
finite-dimensional $\{E_i,F_i,K_i^{\pm1}\}$-stable subspace for each $i$
(rank-one integrability). Then the negative quantum Serre sums

[F1] $K_iF_jK_i^{-1}=q^{-a_{ij}}F_j$ and $K_iE_jK_i^{-1}=q^{a_{ij}}E_j$; hence $F_j$ has weight $m:=-a_{ij}\ge0$ under conjugation by $K_i$, and $[E_i,F_j]=0$ for $i\ne j$ ([[def-drinfeld-jimbo-quantized-enveloping-algebra]], [[def-cyclic-affine-type-a-cartan-datum]]).
